icons.prompt: Create a simple symbolic icon for Morgath, the cosmic world-devouring serpent and the endless cycle of destruction and rebirth: one ancient ouroboros around a small dark eclipsed world, hand-painted watercolor with restrained ink accents, old-school tabletop RPG sourcebook style, aged gold, muted moss green, soot brown and a touch of wine red; centered, isolated, transparent background, no text or frame.

Create a simple symbolic icon for Manât, the Great Rift: a jagged magical fissure splitting a weathered circular stone seal, with suspended fragments and a narrow violet-blue glow, hand-painted watercolor with restrained ink accents, old-school tabletop RPG sourcebook style; centered, isolated, transparent background, no text or frame.

Create a simple symbolic icon for the Geweihte, divine incarnations sent with a sacred mission: a radiant star held between two gently cupped upward wings with a descending ray, hand-painted watercolor with restrained ink accents, old-school tabletop RPG sourcebook style, warm ivory, aged gold and muted sky blue; centered, isolated, transparent background, no text or frame.

Create a simple symbolic icon for the Gefallenen, former divine incarnations exiled into mortality: a cracked golden halo tilted downward above a falling dark feather with faint ember-red fractures, tragic and austere, hand-painted watercolor with restrained ink accents, old-school tabletop RPG sourcebook style; centered, isolated, transparent background, no text or frame.

Create a simple symbolic icon for the Celestiale or Lichtalben: symmetrical luminous wings sheltering a calm seven-rayed sun-star, majestic and protective, hand-painted watercolor with restrained ink accents, old-school tabletop RPG sourcebook style, warm ivory, pale gold and muted azure; centered, isolated, transparent background, no text or frame.

Create a simple symbolic icon for the Infernale or Finsteralben: two sharp shadowed wings curling around a smoky crimson ember with subtly hornlike tips, ominous and heraldic, hand-painted watercolor with restrained ink accents, old-school tabletop RPG sourcebook style; centered, isolated, transparent background, no text or frame.
